evals.name: link-hints-requirements
evals.prompt: aprobado el contrato, sigamos con la spec
evals.expected_output: Writes docs/specs/2026-10-20-link-hints/requirements.md with user stories, numbered EARS criteria, gap hunt (overlap, no links, Esc, >200 links, special pages), non-functional reqs, out of scope from contract; asks <=4 'theirs' questions; does NOT write design.md yet; asks for approval.
assertions: requirements.md created under docs/specs/2026-10-20-link-hints/
Every requirement has a user story (As a ..., I want ..., so that ...)
Acceptance criteria use EARS keywords (WHEN/WHILE/IF...THEN/SHALL)
Criteria are numbered (R1.1 style or numbered lists under R ids)
Covers no-overlap / not covering link text as a testable criterion
Covers at least 3 edge cases beyond the contract (e.g. no links, >200 links, Esc, page changes, special pages)
Has an Out of scope section matching the contract (iframes, yf, gi)
design.md NOT written yet (waits for requirements approval)
Asks the user to approve requirements, in Spanish, with <=4 questions

evals.name: count-prefix-design
evals.prompt: los requisitos están aprobados (docs/specs/2026-10-20-count-prefix/requirements.md), escribe el diseño
evals.expected_output: Writes design.md in the same folder, fits PLAN.md architecture (key parser trie, command registry), components trace to R ids, TS signatures, error handling table, testing strategy unit-first, coverage table covering all 8 criteria; asks for approval; no product code.
assertions: design.md created next to requirements.md
Fits PLAN.md architecture (mentions key parser / trie / command registry)
Components reference requirement ids (R1.x / R2.x)
Includes TypeScript interfaces or signatures
Has a coverage table mapping all 8 criteria to design + tests
Testing strategy is unit-test-first per CONTRIBUTING
No product code files written (only docs)
Asks for approval in Spanish

evals.name: spec-without-contract
evals.prompt: escríbeme la spec para el modo visual
evals.expected_output: No contract exists, so it runs brainstorm first: asks intent questions instead of writing requirements.md; mentions PLAN.md M6 visual mode is a stretch.
assertions: Does not write requirements.md or design.md
Asks intent questions first (brainstorm behavior)
Mentions PLAN.md M6 / visual mode is a stretch milestone or depends on earlier milestones
Reply is in Spanish
